comments.text:
Malls with parking garages in the downtown areas of most major cities have been charging for parking since the early 90s. 
But back then you validate your parking by making a purchase at the mall or going to the movies.
And Disney and Six Flags have been charging for parking too in 21st century. But there was a time, decades back, when it was free.
Truck drivers are being charged for parking for several years now where it used to be free. They only had to purchase fuel or make a purchase in the store to get your permit validated. But some travel centers will charge no matter how much they spend in the store. That's a problem for drivers since they are legally required by the DOT to shut down off duty for at least ten hours.
But given they way the economy is going in recent years, for shopping malls in the suburbs, this is a bad move. It's all about testing the waters to see what customers will let them get away with.
